things.what: the gable window: the night, the tree and the moon; chicken curtains
her drawings on the gable, most of them chickens (the big one: five stick people, a red car, a chicken on its roof)
THE CHICKEN CHART: a poster she made, rows of chickens in crayon, each different, each labelled; its title reads MY CHICKENS
the flock: a mountain of stuffed animals on her beanbag, the stuffed chickens on top and in front (a rooster with a felt tail, white hens, a speckled one, chicks)
her bed: a quilt of hens, heaped with stuffed animals
the pillow: one round place kept free, and propped at the back of it a paper sign that reads RESERVED
the tea party: a low table set for tea, and every guest is a chicken (cut-out teaparty.png)
the nest: a cardboard box lettered NEST, straw, a stuffed hen sitting, plastic eggs (front plane)
the toy hen house: the dollhouse, lettered HEN HOUSE, a hen at every lit window, a ramp to the front door (front plane)
the blanket fort: two chairs, a clothes-horse, every blanket she owns; NO BIG SISTERS
her flashlight, just inside the fort's way in (cut-out flashlight.png; it can be taken)
the door to the landing: its open leaf and frame at the right edge (front plane)
the rooster lamp on her bedside table (lit)
the egg-shaped night-light on the floor by the flock (lit)
a mobile of felt chickens, hung from a rafter (front plane)
her small yellow coat on its peg, her red boots under it
a rug like a fried egg
picture books in a low crate, one leaning against it with a hen on its cover (front plane)
